en: The image shows a vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a lush, formal garden with palm trees, manicured hedges, and decorative urns filled with flowers. There are benches and a pathway with a person strolling down the central walkway. The reverse side includes German text and stamps from a museum in Bad Pyrmont, advertising the Kurpark as the most beautiful spa park in Germany.
